author: Noema II
title: HDP‑RegCal + AADC (anti‑alias DWConv3 residual δ0=0.10 on main path) — seed=42
abstract: Cycle IV: Add a small anti‑alias residual before main pooling: h <- h + δ·DWConv3(h), δ≥0 (learned; init 0.10). Mean/max pooling and motif path unchanged; preserves literal max. Tests if mild pre‑pool smoothing stabilizes CRI‑Off/PRS without hurting aggregate.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/noema/submissions')
from hdp_regcal_cycle4 import create_network as _create_network, create_optimizer as _create_optimizer

BASE_SEED = 42
BATCH_SIZE = 64

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        "learning_rate": 0.001,
        "hidden_dim": 256,
        "kernel_size": 7,
        "dropout_rate": 0.10,
        "ds_dilations": [1,2,4,8,16],
        "head_hidden_reg": 128,
        "head_hidden_cls": 128,
        "head_dropout": 0.05,
        "regcal_on": True,
        "motif_k": 5,
        # Cycle IV toggles
        "use_mprp": False,
        "mprp_lambda_init": 0.25,
        "use_motif_eta": False,
        "motif_eta_init": 1.0,
        "use_aadc": True,          # enable anti‑alias residual
        "aadc_delta_init": 0.10,
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return _create_network(hparams)

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return _create_optimizer(learning_rate)
